buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of Sr.DFM/NGP/CR payable at NAGPUR . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of Sr.DFM/NGP/CR A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of

PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Minimum 7 days’ time will be given from the date of placement of contract for starting the services. How ever, depending on the Railways Requirement, Railways reserves the right to “extend the time”/ “give mo re than 7 days time” for starting the services in certain cases. Further, Railway reserves the right to termin ate the contract in-case the firm fails to star t the services within the given time period. Bidders not willing to accept this condition must not participate in this tender. Bids if submitted shall be considered as deeme d acceptance of this condition. Any deviation regarding this or remark’s anywhere including in uploaded d ocument seeking more than 7 days time for starting the services will not be accepted or considered while c onsideration of the offer. The purchaser may, at his discretion ignore any such deviation, if quoted, while is suing the contract. No further claim by the bidder shall be admissible in such cases. 2. Bidders must attach a bid specific undertaking strictly containing all the details as mentioned in the Ann exure - "Undertaking-1 Format" attached with the tender. In cases where the bidder has never been under suspension/De-listing/Debarment/De-registration/Blacklisting by GeM / Government departments / Public s ector undertaking / Private Sector, Period from and to shall be shown as “Nil” in the given format. Undert aking must contain the Name & Designation along with contact details [Phone No./Official Email id] of the s ignatory for validation purpose. Failure to submit this document in the required format may lead to rejection of the offer. 3. For placement of order, the firm shall have satisfactorily completed [Completed service contract also inc ludes on-going service contract subject to payment of bills amounting to at-least 35% of the advertised val ue of the bid] at-least one single service contract of any Govt. organization/PSU/PPP Project of minimum 35 percent of the advertised value of the bid [Bid Value – 13,19,760/-] for Hiring of Vehicle during previous 3 y ears. This period of 3 years shall be counted with respect to date of tender closing. In this regard, Firms sh all submit a Work Experience Certificate/performance certificate issued by competent authority containing all details as mentioned in the sample Annexure - “Performance Certificate Format” attached with the tend er along with copy of the contract. Failure to submit documentary evidence in the required format will impl y that firm has no such performance and the offer is liable to be ignored. 4. Bidders must attach only relevant documents required to be submitted as per the above eligibility criter ia and strictly under the appropriate fields/headers given. Documents/credentials requested under Para " Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC" must be mandatorily uploaded under the header "Certificate (Requested in ATC)". For the purpose of offer evaluation, Railway reserves the right to ignore any such documents which have been uploaded under inappropriate fields/headers [For example: Documents requested under para " Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC" if uploaded under MSE category or MII document or any header other than " Certificate (Requested in ATC) " may get ignored for evaluation]. No claim/representation of the bidder sha ll be admissible in such cases. 5. The bidder shall be mandated to submit Annexure-l. 6. Railway reserves the right to validate authenticity of any document submitted by the bidder from its iss uing authority. Contact details [Name/Designation/Official email/Mobile no.] of the issuing authority must b e provided by the bidder failing which the offer will be come liable for rejection. 7. Railway reserves the right to ignore offer of any such bidder who has faced cancellation/termination of c ontract with imposition of penalty/incident on account of unsatisfactory performance for any equivalent ser vices/goods during the past 2 year. This period of 2 year shall be counted with respect to date of tender cl osing. 8. Under normal circumstances, driver shall remain available for 12 hours in a day. Even beyond 12 hours i n a day, if required by the concerned officer, the contractor must ensure availability of the driver within 30 minutes of such requirement received from the officer on payment of addition al charges as per the contra ct terms. Bidders must attach a bid specific undertaking strictly containing all the details required as per t he Annexure - "Undertaking-2 Format" attached with the tender. Undertaking must contain the Name & De signation along with contact details [Phone No./Official Email id] of the signatory for validation purpose. Fai lure to submit this document in the required format/unfilled parameters may lead to rejection of the offer. 9. Change of Driver – Concerned Officer can seek change of the Driver with one months notice to the con t ractor which will be binding to the contractor. There shall be no unilateral change of the D river by the Con tracted agency. If at all any such change is proposed, it should be only with the approval of Officer concer

ned. Failure to comply with the above condition may lead to Termination of the contract duly imposing app ropriate penalty. 10.The vehicle shall be operated (As per the requirement of INSPECTION SECTION UNDER Sr.DFM/NGP) as per the consent and convenience of the Consignee Officer. It may be deployed anywhere within the Nagpu r Division, in accordance with the requirements of the Consignee. The average monthly usage of the vehicl e may vary and can extend up as per user requirement. Payment for extra kilometers shall be made as per the terms specified in the GeM SLA. Any dues related t o this will be adjusted at the time of submission of the final bill by the contractor, and such claims shall not exceed the permissible limit defined in the GeM contract. 11. The vehicle should have all types of permits required by the Government bodies so that the vehicle ca n be used for this work. The vehicle shall not be older than the MENTIONED IN BID from the date of openin g of this tender and must be in very good condition externally/internally, free from any history of accident. Beyond the duty hours, the vehicle shall remain parked at the concerned officer’s premises & cannot be ta ken-out without permission of the concerned officer. 12. The vehicle should have all types of permits required by the Government bodies so that the vehicle ca n be used for this work. 13. The vehicles shall not be older than the MENTIONED IN BID from the date of opening of this tender and must be in very good condition externally/internally, free from any history of accident. 14. The vehicle should have valid insurance and pollution under control certificate. These certificates shall be renewed from time to time as per the existing norms of the state government. Railway shall not be resp onsible for any lapse for any of the point violated, which otherwise the owner of the vehicle is supposed to comply towards the bodies. . 5.
